[Prologue]
With the influence of a certain popular anime, an athletic 
half-blooded girl by the name of Roza picks up the sport of cycling.
The road bike that she wanted however, cost a lot more than she expected.
No problem, she gets her Papa to buy it (and her summer wear) for her...
Gathering attention from various men while she rides down the road, 
Roza soon was enlightened to the perilous pleasures of exhibitionism...

* Exhibitionist Cycling!! Travel around the map where you like~!
* Exhibitionist spots on the fields!! Enjoy the various erotic events.
* H scene cut ins!! When men view your erotic display, cut ins are displayed!
* Your parameters are increased by riding over special locations!!
* Win various races, gain bicycle parts for customization challenge your limits!!

- Reminiscence room implemented 

12 base CG events / 20 cut in event types
(Level of nekkidness is reflected in some of the scenes.)

* Requires RPG TKool VX Ace RTP (free): http://dlsite.jp/RPGTKool_eng/

[spoiler=作品内容]■プロローグ
スポーツ万能のハーフ少女ローザが、アニメに影響されロードバイクを始める。
ロードのあまりの値段に驚きつつも、パパにおねだりしてなんとか自分のロード手に入れる。
サイクルウェアももちろんそろえ、町中を流していると、男性の視線が集中していることに気付くローザ。
軽く見せつけ、その場を後にしトイレに行くと、そこにはぐっしょりと湿ったレーパンが……。
見られることの快感を知ってしまったローザは、徐々に大胆になっていく……。

■露出サイクリング!!
フィールドを自由に移動して、自由に露出プレイ!!
露出中に人に見つかると襲われちゃうかも?

■フィールド露出スポット!!
フィールドには数々の露出スポットが存在。
露出スポットで起きるプチHイベントの数々を楽しもう。

■Hカットイン!!
フィールドで男達の視線を集めるとカットインが表示される!
色々なHカットインでイベントを演出!!

■ステータス強化!!
特定のフィールドで自転車に乗り移動することで、ステータスがアップする。
ステータスを強化してレースに挑もう。

■数々のレースを制覇!!
公式レースや草レースが開催される!
レースに勝利して自転車パーツを手に入れよう!!
手に入れた自転車パーツはショップで自由に付け替え!
タイムアタックコースで自分の限界に挑戦!!

■その他機能
・回想ルーム

■シチュエーション
基本CGイベント12種類
・公衆トイレでスパッツ半脱ぎオナニー
・ローター装備でライド
・パンク修理のお礼に道端で手コキフェラ
・ライド後、足湯に入って見下し視線での足コキ
・サドルでオナニー中に男に見つかりそのまま挿入
・サブキャラHイベント(即売会)
・ボディーペイントでライド中に雨がふってきて
・秘境温泉(混浴)で、男たちに囲まれて
・草レースで負けて、ア〇ルプレイ
・峠の最高点で変態オナニー
・深夜の全裸ライド
・大会レース後の輪姦
カットインイベント20種類

現在一部CGには脱衣状態が反映されます。


■追加更新決定!!
リリース後1週間程度を目安に追加更新を行います。
追加内容は新規イベントCG2種類
新規カットインイベント30種類を予定しています。
全裸などの固定イベント以外のHイベントに自分の脱衣状態がCGに反映されるモードを追加。
ブラ無しジャージ開けなど自分な好きなスタイルでイベントを楽しめる予定です。

## **About This Game**
Alice, daughter of the noble Dietrich, her life of aristocracy comes to an end after her father died for some reason. All that was once magnificent is now gone, over a hundred servants were dismissed, mansion sold, jewelry pawned, moreover, huge debt owed to loan sharks. Only the most loyal servant of all, J, stayed and kept Alice company. The once noble miss have to live in a rented dump and to pay up her debt, she is now a bounty hunter. She’ll do whatever paid to do, no matter how difficult or graceless it is.

Hilda, women delegate of Eden Church, is a rising star by her breathtaking beauty and incredible sexuality. Her ruthlessness made her willingly give up anything to achieve her objective. Her unspeakable experience in Schramm has made her go ballistic when touched. The king drown in her unbelievable attractiveness and was finally brought to her knee, which led to her total domination of his country. The only enemy she considered comparable to her beauty is Alice, and as her envy implodes, she’ll do whatever it takes, however disgraceful or dirty, to make her a sex tool.

Battle mode of this game is traditional turn-based-RPG, of which party with higher speed makes the first move. Battle command involves attack, abilities, magic, props and flee. But for further reference, all battles are objectively one-on-one, which means all enemies are considered as a group when attack. And the character will automatically choose to flee if CE(Combat Effectiveness) of enemies is way too high. And when defeated, game will not end, but rather trigger some unspeakable event (winky face with nothing but INNOCENT smile).

As a Japanese-style RPG, our game provides you a rather open and free world. For example you can roam in the street wearing no undies, barge in to bathing pool for man just for a rush, sell used underwear to complete strangers with acquired taste, be a common prostitute in any brothel for the unique experience, or just simply beat a NPC to death because you feel like it.

So, how will life of Alice turn out? Will she redeem her noble name and life? Or will she just abandon herself and become a sex tool? Will she become something evil, or remain a virgin to her Good End? All of that is for you to decide!

**Information:**

**Title / タイトル:** 最強ハンターがモンスター娘のレベルドレインで弱くされ逆レイプされるRPG / The Ultimate Hunter Falls Prey to a Monster Girl Level Draining Reverse R*P*G

**Release / 販売日:** 2017/07/25
**File size / ファイル容量:**

[![](http://imageteam.org/upload/small/2017/08/29/59a59dcd90f9a.jpg)](http://imageteam.org/img-59a59dcd90fd6.html) [![](http://imgtornado.com/upload/small/2017/08/29/59a59de307f34.jpg)](http://imgtornado.com/img-59a59de307f6a.html) [![](http://dimtus.com/upload/small/2017/08/29/59a59dd7bcfee.jpg)](http://dimtus.com/img-59a59dd7bd026.html) [![](http://main.imgclick.net/i/01013/0zxs1d9439ns_t.jpg)](http://imgclick.net/0zxs1d9439ns/RJ204483_img_smp4.jpg.html)

-------Story-------
Level 99, the ultimate hunter (YOU) make your way to a certain tower 
as part of a quest but... that tower is full of level draining monster girls!

You would usually defeat such small fry effortlessly, 
but today is...? is not...? (you be the judge!) your lucky day...

Recommended for those who:
- want to be level drained!
- love monster girls!
- love being defeated!
- love status effects and traps!
- feel that humiliation is so great!
- are bored of normal RPG systems!
- want to be reverse r*ped during battle!
--------------------

-----System-----
This game is designed with two phases.

"Escaping from Level Drain Phase"
Upon entering the tower, the enemies approach you.
If you are caught, you must attempt your best to escape 
from the ensuing reverse r*pe and level draining!
The more that you are drained, the harder it will 
be to escape as you grow weaker and weaker.
(If you find it too difficult, please refer to the 
game hints / tips file provided in the retail version.)

"Fighting while being Level Drained Phase"
In this phase, use the mouse to fight with your enemies.
Enemies will also attempt level draining so you 
may just find yourself in a game over situation.
The details are provided in the retail version's readme.
--------------------

* Recommend purchase with DLsite account for updates.
* Confirm system compatibility via the trial version.

Illustration: Wakame Kirimugi 
Text / Overall Compilation: Iruka Oruka

[spoiler=作品内容]---story---
Lv99の最強ハンターの主人公はとある以来で塔に挑む。
しかし塔にはモンスター娘が住んでおり、レベルをドレインされてしまう!
本来なら格下の、雑魚も同然の相手に苦戦し、挙句の果てに服従させられてしまう...

☆こんな方にお勧め☆
・レベルドレインされたい!
・モンスター娘が好き!
・負けるのが好き!
・状態異常とか罠とか好き!
・屈辱こそが至高!
・普通のRPGシステムに飽きた!
・戦闘中も逆レイプされたい!

---system---
このゲームは「レベルドレインから逃げるフェーズ」と「レベルドレインされながら戦うフェーズ」の2フェーズで攻略していく仕様となっております。

「レベルドレインから逃げるフェーズ」
塔に入ると、敵が主人公に近づいてきます。
捕まれば逆レイプ・レベルドレイン!必死に逃げましょう!
ドレインされればされるほど逃げにくくなり、どんどんと弱っていきます。
どうしても逃げきれない方は、製品版添付ファイルの攻略指南をご確認ください。

「レベルドレインされながら戦うフェーズ」
こちらでは、マウスを用いて敵と戦闘を行います。
詳細は添付ファイルをご確認ください。
こちらでも敵はレベルドレインを行ってきますが、回避不能で詰みとなる場合も御座います。
ご了承願います。

### **[ABOUT THIS GAME](http://store.steampowered.com/app/665180/Dark_Elf/),**

Trading cards: According to new policy of Steam, trading cards will be available when the quantity of copies of game sold reachs a certain amount. 

It’s a story about a dark elf and a teenager who survived from death field after experiencing countless death.
The background is that after the war and in the peaceful world, Frelia the former mercenary saved the young Ruse who was attacked, and took him in.

Heroine: Fraylia
A very haughty dark elf and female warrior
CV: Inukai Ao
BWH: B90 (G cup) W57 H95
During the world war, as a mercenary she lived in the smoke of war.
After the war, she worked in the city’s trade union as she traveled around the world.
Once when repelled a monster she saved the young Ruse and took him in.
The two lived in Orucu and depended on each other.

Hero: Ruse
The teenager living with Fraylia
Many years ago, he was saved by Frelia when a monster attacked the orphanage where he lived.
At the beginning he didn’t open his mind and then he generally talked with her about everything.
Ruse has always been reading books at home for his bad health.
His dream was to become a national scholar.

Various Storylines
Is it a happy ending? Or is it to degenerate happily?
Seven RPG can be used for the end of storylines.
Two general directions:

1. Normal line
The two lived together. Fraylia strives to help Ruse become an independent and strong man.
According to different options of storylines, she could be a virgin at the end of the game.

2.Sinner line
When her specific work fails, there will be another line.
Fraylia regarded as a sinner can release her instinct power after lots of insults.
Ruse leaves. In order to see him again, she has to do some illegal work that her country arranges for her.
